title: 第18章 石像鬼之心第19章 圣剑升级

第十八章 石像鬼之心
“罗德先生！我们找到了！”
听到这个声音，罗德立刻回头望去，只见梅斯带着一面惊喜站在教堂门口，手中高高举着一个精美的小雕像，上面雕刻的是一只蜷缩在一起的石像鬼，两只由红宝石碎片所制成的眼睛正隐隐约约的散发出一丝暗红的光彩。那正是控制中枢！
而梅斯的喊话也引起了石像鬼的注意，作为炼金生物，它们当然知道对方手里拿的是什么，很快，两只石像鬼就立刻转移方向，向梅斯冲了过去。
“呜哇！”
看见两只可怕的怪物向自己冲来，梅斯吓的不由怪叫一声，他下意识的想要转身逃跑，而就在这时，罗德的声音却已经传到。
“把它扔过来！”
虽然望着这两个凶神恶煞的怪物，梅斯有一种自己下一瞬间就会被它们彻底撕碎的错觉，但是他还是硬着头皮，扔出了手中那个黑色的，制做精美的雕像。
不得不说，胖商人的准头的确不怎么样，他扔出去的东西在空中划过一道弧线，却是歪歪斜斜的偏离了原本的轨道，根本就没有扔到罗德的身边，反而超着那两只石像鬼飞了过去，如果是不知情的人看见这一幕，还以为胖商人和这两个石像鬼是一伙儿的也说不定。而面对送上门来的大礼，石像鬼也是一愣，不过它还是下意识的伸出爪子，试图握住这个小小的雕像。
不过就在它即将要得逞的瞬间，一股微风从它的身下飞过，几乎已经丧失了形体的灵魂之鸟在空中带过一连串半透明的波动，硬生生的抢下了雕像。
这是罗德最后的力量，消耗殆尽的他不得不收起了手中的长剑，同时右手向上，打了一个响指。
伴随着这个声音，灵魂之鸟优美的在空中划过，接着向罗德飞了过来。而那两只石像鬼却也是中途立刻停下身形，重新转移了方向。
“唰！！”
奔跑在地面上的石像鬼一个翻身，粗壮修长的尾巴猛然甩过，重重打在了灵魂之鸟的身上，虽然它并没有造成多大的伤害，但是包裹，围绕着灵魂之鸟盘旋的青色风元素却是微微一乱，连带着鸟儿的身形也是一歪。
青之鸟并没有放弃前进，它依旧努力的拍打翅膀，从地面上飞快的掠过，努力的向自己的主人飞去。
但是它并没有如愿到达目的地。
一只石制的巨爪从天而降，穿透了青之鸟的身体，紊乱的风之元素再也无法维持凝结身体的力量，瞬间便化为了最原始的存在消逝不见。而原本被鸟儿叼在嘴中的黑色雕像也因此飞了出去，不过很快，两个漆黑的身影从后面追来，它们伸出利爪，张开大嘴，伸向了眼前的雕像———直到它安静而平稳的落入罗德的手中。
[已获得石像鬼控制中枢，鉴定完毕]
[指令———]
“Aig！”

罗德的声音并不大，甚至有些低沉。但是那原本进行攻击的黑影们此刻却产生了变化——原本还有些发亮的身躯在眨眼间变的暗淡无光，在空中伸展的肢体仿佛被凝固似的停了下来，而石像鬼面上那本来燃烧着诡异的红色光芒也在瞬间消逝。
随后，两道黑影就这么与罗德擦身而过，重重砸在了他身后的地面上。
“轰！！！”
伴随着碰撞声，失去了动力的石像鬼重变回了原本的雕塑，它们保持着刚才向前飞扑的动作，此刻正安静的躺在罗德身后不远处的地面上。只不过在失去了魔力的支援之后，它们已经不象之前那么坚硬，这一撞之下，两个石像鬼都是不由的散了架，由原本的艺术雕塑变成了毫无价值的垃圾。
“呼…………”
直到这时，罗德才松了口气。此刻的他只感到混身乏力，灵魂力量的过量消耗让他双腿发软，甚至连握着雕像的右手手指都使不上力气。不过在表面上，罗德还是一副冷静的表情，他沉默的站在原地，片刻之后才将雕像放入口袋之中。
“罗德先生！”
而就在这时，莉洁和梅斯也跑到了他的面前，带着担忧和焦急的表情望着他。
“您没事吧！？”
“我还好。”
罗德深深的吸了口气，他现在实在很想坐下休息一会，虽然在游戏中，灵魂力量消耗过度也会有各种各样的表现，但是真正在自己身上体会到还是让他感觉有些吃不消，但是他现在不能倒下。
不过幸运的是，周边的浓雾里已经看不见那些幽鬼的身影，似乎它们在无法靠近之后，终于做出了放弃的选择，远离了这片禁地。
虽然这并不代表它们已经放弃，不过眼下也总算是件好事。但是罗德并没有太多的表示，这也是他担任团长以来的习惯，一个团队的指挥者必须要时刻保持冷静，不能够因为一点小事而慌张失措。如果因为稍微遇到点困难就大喊大叫，或者打败强敌就兴奋的忘乎所以，那么对自己的部下带来的可绝对不会是什么正面影响。现在的罗德虽然已经不再是公会之中那个统辖数万玩家的公会会长，但是这种习惯却还是在影响着他。
不过不得不说，看到他冷静的表现，让有些紧张的莉洁和梅斯都松了口气。毕竟他们在翻找过程中也一直担心着外面的情况，生怕出现什么问题。莉洁非常努力，不过在鉴定物品方面梅斯显然更胜一筹，终于在一个小角落里发现了这个小小的雕像，不得不说，他们的运气还真不错，如果再晚片刻，说不定情况就会完全不同。
原本罗德的打算是以最快速度穿过迷雾废墟，但是两只石像鬼的出现却不得不让他改变主意，毕竟这两只石像鬼几乎把他的力量彻底消耗完了，如果不好好休息恢复一下的话，那么接下来的战斗会更加凶险。所以罗德最终决定在教堂内休息一晚，第二天再继续出发。他倒不担心这里会出现什么意外，在游戏中的副本里，这座教堂也是不少玩家用来休息和整理战利品的地方，所以倒也不会有什么大的问题。
虽然梅斯望着这黑漆漆的教堂和那些令人毛骨悚然的装饰就腿肚子发抽，可惜一如既往的………他并没有什么话语权来反对罗德的决定。
天色渐渐暗了下来。
浓密的雾气在教堂外徘徊，透过窗户望去，除了白茫茫的一片之外什么也看不见。三人坐在教堂的中心，那些已经被废弃，腐烂的礼拜长椅和桌子则成为了木柴，正在燃烧的火堆中发挥最后一点余热，阴冷的风从破烂的窗户缺口和墙壁裂缝中吹来，带着丝丝的寒意。
莉洁小心翼翼的伸出手去，拆开罗德左胸的绷带，接着她那好看的眉头微微一皱。
“又裂开了，罗德先生。”

“我知道。”
罗德点了点头，没有多说什么。事实上这也不是第一次了，毕竟一路走来，都是罗德在前面战斗，虽然考虑到胸口的伤势，他已经尽量避免用上左手，但是遇到一些特别讨厌的麻烦时就顾不上这么多，而这也导致他的伤口不时开裂，按照莉洁的话来说，本来只要静养两三天就能好的伤，这么一搞说不定十几天都无法回复。
不过少女也没有办法抱怨什么，这毕竟都是为了他们，所以莉洁唯一能做的，就是每天帮罗德更换干净的绷带以避免伤口感染，幸运的是在离开浮空船之前，作为一个灵师她没有少携带这些东西。
将绷带拆开之后，火光映照下的伤口让所有人都不由的倒吸了口冷气，梅斯甚至还心有余悸的摸了摸自己的胸前，有些害怕的望着罗德的胸口。在那里，三道足有小臂般粗细的黑色爪痕浮现在罗德的胸口，到处都是鲜血结出的黑色疤痕，而因为之前与石像鬼的激烈战斗，不少疤痕都被撕裂开来，鲜红的血液从中渗出，与那些已经发黑的血块混合在一起，光是看都让人觉得内心发寒。
莉洁拿出手帕，从水壶中倒了些清水，接着按在罗德的胸口，这让后者的身体本能的抽搐了下，甚至连梅斯都露出了不忍的目光，直接转过头去，不想再看。
“对，对不起，很疼吗？”
“没事。”
面对莉洁慌张的询问，罗德摇了摇头，虽然的确有些疼，但是还没有到达无法忍耐的程度。
听到罗德的回答，莉洁松了口气，继续擦拭着罗德身上的伤口，与此同时，少女也开始偷偷打量起眼前这个比自己略大的年轻男子。
坦白来说，第一次见面的时候，罗德留给莉洁的印象很一般，因为他长的很漂亮，皮肤也很白，所以莉洁下意识的就把他看成了那种贵族子弟。不过因为罗德的态度并不象莉洁曾经见过的那些贵族子弟那么嚣张，所以莉洁还能够接受，但是那个时候她并没有把对方看的太重，毕竟，一个看起来象女人的男人，给人的第一印象大都是软弱的。
但是随后，莉洁的看法慢慢改变了。
和那些手无缚鸡之力的贵族子弟不同，这个年轻男子拥有相当强的力量，甚至不亚于自己的团长，而且他的性格非常沉稳，跟随在他的身边会让人感到非常安心，哪怕是面对危险，也不会慌乱。而且与他的外表不同，这是一个非常坚强的男人。
莉洁知道这种伤势有多么痛苦，她作为灵师给不少人治疗过，很多在战场上不皱一下眉头的猛汉在治疗伤口时却都会大呼小叫，但是罗德由始至终都没有哼出过半声，更不用说，他还带着这么重的伤站在前面战斗……
莉洁的手停了一下。
自己在想什么？真是乱七八糟。
少女摇了摇头，把脑中那些古怪的念头抛到脑后，接着，她继续开始自己的工作。
罗德并没有注意到身边少女的异样，此刻他的注意力正集中在右手上，在他的手掌中心，正躺着两块散发着暗红色光彩的宝石。
那正是罗德从这次战斗中所获得的战利品之一，石像鬼之心。

Chapter 18 Gargoyle Heart
"Mr. Rhodes! We found it!"
Hearing this voice, Rhodes immediately looked back and saw Mace standing at the door of the church with a surprise, holding a beautiful small statue high in his hand, which was carved with a huddled gargoyle. Two eyes made of ruby ​​shards were faintly emitting a hint of dark red brilliance. That is the control center!
Mace's shout also attracted the attention of the gargoyles. As alchemy creatures, they certainly knew what the other party was holding. Soon, the two gargoyles immediately changed direction and rushed towards Mace.
"Whoa!"
Seeing two terrifying monsters charging towards him, Mace couldn't help but scream in fear. He subconsciously wanted to turn around and run away, but at this moment, Rhodes' voice had already reached him.
"Throw it over!"
Although looking at these two ferocious monsters, Mace had the illusion that he would be completely torn apart by them in the next moment, but he still bit the bullet and threw out the black, beautifully crafted statue in his hand.
It has to be said that the fat businessman's accuracy was indeed not very good. The object he threw drew an arc in the air, but deviated crookedly from its original trajectory. It did not throw it to Rhodes at all, but flew past the two gargoyles. If an uninformed person saw this scene, he might have thought that the fat businessman and the two gargoyles were in the same group. Facing the big gift that came to his door, the gargoyle was also stunned, but it still subconsciously stretched out its claws and tried to hold the small statue.
But just when it was about to succeed, a breeze flew under it, and the soul bird, which had almost lost its body, passed through a series of translucent fluctuations in the air and snatched the statue away.
This was Rhode's last strength. When it was exhausted, he had to put away the long sword in his hand. At the same time, he raised his right hand and snapped his fingers.
Along with this sound, the soul bird flew gracefully through the air, and then flew towards Rhodes. But the two gargoyles immediately stopped midway and changed their direction.
"Shua!!"
The gargoyle running on the ground turned over, and its thick and slender tail suddenly swung over and hit the soul bird hard. Although it did not cause much damage, the cyan wind element that wrapped and circled around the soul bird was slightly chaotic, and the bird's body shape was also distorted.
The blue bird did not give up its progress, it still flapped its wings hard, flew quickly from the ground, and flew hard to its master.
But it didn't reach its destination.
A huge stone claw fell from the sky and penetrated the Blue Bird's body. The chaotic wind element could no longer maintain the power of the condensed body, and instantly transformed into the most primitive existence and disappeared. The black statue that was originally held in the bird's mouth also flew out, but soon, two dark figures chased from behind. They extended their claws, opened their mouths, and reached for the statue in front of them - until it fell quietly and smoothly into Rhodes' hands.
[The gargoyle control center has been obtained and the identification has been completed]
[Command————]
"Aig!"
Rhodes' voice was not loud, even a little deep. But the black shadows that were originally attacking changed at this moment - the originally shiny bodies turned dim in the blink of an eye, the limbs stretched in the air stopped as if they were solidified, and the strange red light on the gargoyle's face also disappeared in an instant.
Then, two black shadows just passed by Rhodes and hit the ground behind him heavily.
"Boom!!!"
With the sound of collision, the gargoyles that had lost their power transformed back into their original sculptures. They maintained their swooping forward motion and were lying quietly next to Rhodes.On the ground not far behind. However, after losing the support of magic power, they were no longer as hard as before. Under this collision, the two gargoyles couldn't help but fall apart, turning from the original artistic sculptures into worthless garbage.
"Huh..."
Only then did Rhodes relax. At this moment, he only felt exhausted. The excessive consumption of soul power made his legs weak, and he couldn't even use the fingers of his right hand holding the statue. However, on the surface, Rhodes still had a calm expression. He stood silently and put the statue into his pocket after a moment.
"Mr. Rhodes!"
At this moment, Li Jie and Metz also ran up to him, looking at him with worried and anxious expressions.
"Are you okay!?"
"I'm fine."
Rhodes took a deep breath. He really wanted to sit down and rest for a while. Although in the game, excessive consumption of soul power would have various manifestations, but actually experiencing it on his own body still made him feel a bit overwhelmed, but he could not fall down now.
Fortunately, the ghosts were no longer visible in the thick fog around them. It seemed that after being unable to get close, they finally made the choice to give up and stay away from this forbidden land.
Although this does not mean that they have given up, it is still a good thing at the moment. But Rhodes didn't express much. This has been his habit since he became the team leader. The leader of a team must remain calm at all times and cannot panic over trivial matters. If you yell because you encounter a slight difficulty, or if you get carried away with excitement after defeating a strong enemy, then it will definitely not have a positive impact on your subordinates. Although Rhodes is no longer the guild leader who oversees tens of thousands of players in the guild, this habit is still affecting him.
But I have to say that seeing his calm performance made both Li Jie and Metz relieved, who were a little nervous. After all, they were always worried about the situation outside during the rummaging process, for fear that something might go wrong. Li Jie worked very hard, but Mace was obviously better at identifying items, and finally found this small statue in a small corner. It must be said that their luck was really good. If it had been a moment later, the situation might have been completely different.
Rhodes' original plan was to pass through the foggy ruins as quickly as possible, but the appearance of two gargoyles forced him to change his mind. After all, these two gargoyles had almost completely consumed his power. If he didn't take a good rest and recover, the next battle would be even more dangerous. So Rhodes finally decided to rest in the church for one night and set off again the next day. He wasn't worried about any accidents happening here. In the game's dungeon, this church was also a place where many players rested and sorted out their loot, so there wouldn't be any big problems.
Although Mace's stomach twitched when he looked at the dark church and the creepy decorations, unfortunately, as always... he didn't have much say in opposing Rhodes' decision.
The sky gradually darkened.
Thick fog lingered outside the church, and when I looked through the windows, I could see nothing but a vast expanse of white. The three of them were sitting in the center of the church. The abandoned and rotten worship benches and tables had become firewood. The last remaining heat was exerted in the burning fire. The cold wind blew from the broken windows and cracks in the walls, bringing with it the slightest chill.
Li Jie carefully reached out her hand and took off the bandage on Rhode's left chest, then her beautiful brows wrinkled slightly.
"Cracked again, Mr. Rhodes."
"I know."
Rhodes nodded and said nothing more. In fact, this is not the first time. After all, Rhodes has been fighting in front along the way. Although considering the pain in his chest,As for the injury, he had tried to avoid using his left hand, but when he encountered some particularly annoying troubles, he couldn't care so much, and this also caused his wounds to crack from time to time. According to Li Jie, the injury would have healed as long as two or three days of rest, but he might not be able to recover after more than ten days.
But the girl couldn't complain. After all, it was all for them, so the only thing Li Jie could do was to help Rhodes change clean bandages every day to avoid wound infection. Fortunately, as a spiritual master, she did not miss these things before leaving the floating ship.
After taking off the bandage, the wounds illuminated by the fire made everyone gasp. Mace even touched his chest with lingering fear and looked at Rhodes' chest with some fear. There, three black claw marks as thick as forearms appeared on Rhodes' chest, and there were black scars made of blood everywhere. Due to the fierce battle with the gargoyles, many scars were torn open, and bright red blood seeped out from them, mixing with the blackened blood clots. Just looking at it made people feel chilly inside.
Li Jie took out a handkerchief, poured some water from the kettle, and then pressed it on Rhodes' chest, which made the latter's body twitch instinctively. Even Mace showed an unbearable look and turned his head directly, not wanting to look anymore.
"Yes, I'm sorry, does it hurt?"
"It's okay."
Facing Li Jie's panicked inquiry, Rhodes shook his head. Although it did hurt a little, it had not reached an unbearable level.
Hearing Rhode's answer, Li Jie breathed a sigh of relief and continued to wipe the wounds on Rhode's body. At the same time, the girl also began to secretly look at the young man in front of her who was slightly older than herself.
Frankly speaking, when they first met, Rhodes left a very average impression on Li Jie. Because he was very beautiful and his skin was very white, Li Jie subconsciously regarded him as that kind of aristocratic child. However, because Rhodes' attitude was not as arrogant as that of the aristocratic children that Li Jie had seen before, Li Jie could still accept it, but at that time she did not take him too seriously. After all, the first impression of a man who looks like a woman is that he is weak.
But then, Li Jie's view slowly changed.
Unlike those aristocratic children who are powerless, this young man has considerable strength, even as much as his own captain, and he has a very calm character. Following him will make people feel very at ease, and he will not panic even in the face of danger. And unlike his appearance, this is a very strong man.
Li Jie knew how painful this kind of injury was. As a healer, she had treated many people. Many fierce men who did not frown on the battlefield would yell when treating their wounds. However, Rhodes never hummed even half a sound, not to mention that he was standing in front of the battle with such a serious injury...
Li Jie's hand stopped for a moment.
What are you thinking about? What a mess.
The girl shook her head, throwing away those weird thoughts in her mind, and then she continued to start her work.
Rhodes didn't notice anything strange about the girl next to him. At this moment, his attention was focused on his right hand. In the center of his palm, there were two gems that exuded dark red light.
That was one of the trophies Rhodes obtained from this battle, the Gargoyle Heart.
